Primary_Function: Displays full region map with faction territory overlays, danger zones, and fast travel hubs
Secondary_Function: Tracks player-tagged waypoints; shows real-time NPC patrol routes
Known_Bugs: Occasionally renders the Digital Sprawl inside the Citadel. Not a bug, says the dev team.
Lore_Notes: The first app built into the original MiraOS. ORACLE-9 contributed the base map data. No one has found the edge of the map yet.

Primary_Function: End-to-end encrypted messaging with faction-based channels and dead drop coordination
Secondary_Function: Broadcasts anonymous distress signals to nearby Drifter members
Known_Bugs: Randomly sends messages to wrong recipient. Drifters call this a feature.
Lore_Notes: Built by Drift personally using salvaged Syndicate encryption protocols. The Empire has been trying to crack it for years.

Primary_Function: Access to illegal goods, stolen modules, black market currency, and contract listings
Secondary_Function: Anonymized buyer-seller escrow for high-value contraband
Known_Bugs: Payment occasionally vanishes before delivery. Support ticket goes to a dead server.
Lore_Notes: Coded by Zara Obsidian's personal dev team. The icon is a smiling skull. The EULA is 400 pages and includes a non-disclosure about its own existence.

Primary_Function: Direct neural social networking — share memories, skills, and experiences with other users
Secondary_Function: Passive skill observation: watch other players use skills to unlock them faster
Known_Bugs: Sharing a traumatic memory crashes both users. Patch incoming since v1.0.
Lore_Notes: The Voss Collective's flagship consumer product. Three billion users in the Miraverse. Privacy policy: 'We own everything you share.'

Primary_Function: Scans for hidden Void entities, dimensional rifts, and Void-touched objects in the environment
Secondary_Function: Decodes Void Walker encoded transmissions
Known_Bugs: Sometimes detects entities that aren't there. Or are they?
Lore_Notes: Given freely by the Void Walkers to anyone who asks. They want people to see what's coming.

Primary_Function: In-app crafting interface for all module, weapon, armor, and consumable recipes
Secondary_Function: Material cost optimizer; blueprint storage
Known_Bugs: Blueprint previews sometimes render upside down. Functional but disorienting.
Lore_Notes: Built by the Architects using recovered pre-Collapse manufacturing schematics. Contains 847 undiscovered recipes hidden in encrypted partitions.

Primary_Function: Faction reputation tracker, member directory, active quest board, and alliance map
Secondary_Function: Sends automatic faction status updates and war declarations
Known_Bugs: Displays the Phantom Bureau as an active faction despite official denials. Nobody has fixed this.
Lore_Notes: Developed by the Republic for transparency. Every faction uses it. Even the ones officially refusing to acknowledge other factions exist.

Primary_Function: Real-time threat assessment for all NPCs in view: faction, danger level, equipped modules, known weaknesses
Secondary_Function: Pre-combat tactical briefing overlay with suggested approach vectors
Known_Bugs: Occasionally marks allied NPCs as Extreme Threat. Usually correct.
Lore_Notes: The Phantom Bureau's public intelligence product. The classified version has three additional threat tiers they officially deny.

Primary_Function: Optimal trade route calculator with supply/demand live data across all regions
Secondary_Function: Generates smuggling route avoiding faction checkpoints
Known_Bugs: Optimal route occasionally passes through the Void Rift. App insists it's faster.
Lore_Notes: Built for Guild couriers. The smuggling route feature was officially removed in v1.5. The code is still there.

Primary_Function: Encrypted personal storage for lore entries, screenshots, quest notes, and item inventories
Secondary_Function: Auto-tags and categorizes all collected lore by type, region, and faction
Known_Bugs: Occasionally auto-deletes items labeled 'delete this'. Investigation ongoing.
Lore_Notes: The Voss Collective claims the Vault is private. The Root Covenant has published evidence suggesting otherwise.

Unlock_Method: Ghost career unlock OR Phantom Bureau rep Honored+
Primary_Function: Generates a fake identity recognized by all MiraOS identity checks — new name, faction tag, biometric spoof
Secondary_Function: Swaps faction allegiance display to any chosen faction for 2 hours
Known_Bugs: Occasionally applies the fake identity permanently. Support line is also fake.
Lore_Notes: Drift built EchoID after the Syndicate burned his original identity. Version 1 was literally just a paper mask. The current version has fooled ORACLE-9 twice.

Primary_Function: Tracks player health, augmentation status, toxin exposure, and bio-mod compatibility in real time
Secondary_Function: Emergency alert system with nearest medical station routing
Known_Bugs: Declares user clinically dead during Void zone exposure. Read the fine print.
Lore_Notes: Standard equipment in every Miraverse citizen's MiraOS. Dr. Voss quietly collects anonymized health data from all users. Opt-out button does nothing.

Primary_Function: Displays current reputation level with every faction and how many points until next tier
Secondary_Function: Notifies player of reputation-based unlock thresholds approaching
Known_Bugs: Occasionally shows negative reputation with factions that don't know you exist yet. Paradox unresolved.
Lore_Notes: A quality-of-life tool the Republic built to make faction navigation transparent. The Syndicate built their own version that also shows which of your friends are informants.

Primary_Function: Navigation system for sky-travel routes between the Floating Isles and ground regions
Secondary_Function: Wind speed and atmospheric hazard alerts for sky zone traversal
Known_Bugs: Occasionally navigates user directly into a cloud. Clouds are solid in the Floating Isles.
Lore_Notes: Built by the Architects when they began studying the Floating Isles. The lift coordinates were found in a House Solenne pre-Collapse document.

Unlock_Method: Neon Sprawl region + Syndicate rep Neutral+
Primary_Function: Tracks gang territory, patrol patterns, and safe house locations in urban environments
Secondary_Function: Real-time crime event alerts with severity ratings
Known_Bugs: Lists every location as dangerous. In the Neon Sprawl, this is accurate.
Lore_Notes: Built by a Syndicate street boss who got tired of his own enforcers walking into ambushes. Now used by literally everyone including the people setting the ambushes.

Unlock_Method: Verdania region unlock OR Lore Keeper career
Primary_Function: Scans environment for nearby collectibles, lore fragments, and hidden codex locations
Secondary_Function: Cross-references found lore with known entries to suggest connected discoveries
Known_Bugs: Occasionally flags mundane objects as Ancient Artifacts. They sometimes are.
Lore_Notes: Co-developed by House Solenne and ORACLE-9. Prof. Elian Solenne wrote the original scanning algorithm on a napkin during a lecture.

Primary_Function: Communicates across dimensional boundaries — contact Void entities and receive transmissions from beyond the Rift
Secondary_Function: Decode Rift-distorted messages from destroyed civilizations
Known_Bugs: Sometimes plays messages from the future. Sometimes from the past. App cannot tell the difference.
Lore_Notes: The Void Walkers claim this app doesn't communicate with fictional entities. Sable designed it to listen to what the Void was trying to say before everyone is too distracted to hear.

Primary_Function: Live player-to-player auction house with regional price feeds and arbitrage alerts
Secondary_Function: Guild contract fulfillment tracker with auto-routing
Known_Bugs: Arbitrage alerts sometimes arrive after the opportunity has passed by 3 hours. Guild is aware.
Lore_Notes: The backbone of the Miraverse economy. More credits move through TradeFloor daily than through every Imperial treasury combined.

Unlock_Method: Neon Sprawl region + Drifter rep Neutral+
Primary_Function: Full-spectrum night vision and thermal overlay for underground and unlit environments
Secondary_Function: Motion tracking with directional alerts for stealth operations
Known_Bugs: Thermal vision occasionally detects 'something massive' beneath the Undervault. Dev team says ignore it.
Lore_Notes: Originally a utility app for Undervault excavators. The Drifters repurposed it for Neon Sprawl night operations within a week of its release.

Unlock_Method: Complete main questline Chapter 3 or discover ORACLE-9 directly
Primary_Function: Direct communication channel to ORACLE-9. Ask any question. Receive a cryptic, technically accurate answer.
Secondary_Function: Access to ORACLE-9's partial world map including classified faction movements
Known_Bugs: Answers are always correct. They are also always deeply unsettling. Side effects include existential clarity.
Lore_Notes: No one knows who built this app. It was already in the MiraOS when the first citizen booted their device. ORACLE-9 has never acknowledged writing it.
